title: Preserve dead-slapped beats without reducing them to rests
scope: Retain the DeadSlapped annotation independently from empty/rest beat structure.
acceptance: A note-free dead slap stays annotated after public import/export, with its source beat status explicitly defined.
Compare an ordinary rest, empty beat and dead slap without the existing broad dead-slap normalization hiding the mark.
The exact target annotation survives independently and no note is fabricated to simulate it.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Presence-sensitive DeadSlapped decoding accepts any present element spelling.
Pinned facts retain deadSlapped, isEmpty, isRest, and note counts without broad rest normalization.
Covers actual fixtures, rest/empty/dead structure, presence spelling, direct edits, wire shape, Go reimport, nonmutation, and strict policy.
Pinned AlphaTab checks the colors occurrence and all nine dead-slap fixture occurrences before and after export.

Checked note-free dead slaps, ordinary rest/empty distinctions, presence semantics, direct toggles, exact independent marker locations, occurrence ownership, and no fabricated notes or implied note/slap effects. Explicit empty-beat normalization remains separate and reported.

resolution: Added Beat.DeadSlapped as an independent authored beat marker. GPIF element presence maps to true even when element text says false. Note-free marked beats import as BeatStatusNormal; ordinary note-free beats remain rests. GP8 writes DeadSlapped iff the field is true, writes no synthetic Notes element, and does not mutate status, notes, note kinds, or tap/slap/pop effects. M10-DEAD-SLAP covers actual GP7 colors and dead-slap fixtures, the ordinary-rest/explicit-empty/dead-slap distinction, marker absence and text-bearing presence, direct toggles, exact wire output, Go reimport, nonmutation, strict parsing, binary-source exclusion, and pinned AlphaTab deadSlapped/isEmpty/isRest/note-count facts. The 364-fixture structural probe retained the exact fixture set and changed only the two dead-slap comparisons: colors.gp moved from 1/0 different to 1/1 equal-nondefault and dead-slap.gp moved from 9/0 different to 9/9 equal-nondefault. Recognizing the marker removed exactly one and five corresponding generic unknown-element diagnostics; no report or unrelated capability comparison changed. GP3 through GP5 and rendering/playback remain outside this contract.
